summary: Verified all three tool-popover bug fixes in /app/frontend/app/draw/[id].tsx on PHONE (390x844) and TABLET (1024x768). FIX #1 (small chips): all 6 opt-quick-0..5 chips measure exactly 22x22 with borderRadius 11 (computed CSS: width=22px, height=22px, border-radius=11px), and border widths are 2px on the active chip vs 1px on inactive chips — confirmed by inspecting computed style of each chip. FIX #2 (aligned with tapped tool): with default toolbarPos='left', the popover.top ≈ pen.y - 12; measured |card.y - pen.y| = 5.0 on both phone and tablet, well within the 20 pt tolerance. FIX #3 (never covers toolbar): card.x = 66 on both viewports, which is ≥ 60 (TOOLBAR_THICKNESS) and ≥ pen.right (51.5), so there is no overlap; card fits within viewport (66+260=326 < 390 phone, and well within 1024 tablet). Popover interior still contains all required elements: 'Pen settings' title, Fountain/Ballpoint variant chips (variant-pen-fountain / variant-pen-ballpoint), thickness slider with '3.0 pt' readout, 6 smaller quick-color chips (opt-quick-0..5), and 'More colors…' link. Screenshots captured. All acceptance criteria met.
